name: recoil_app_mission_fmv_on_try_become_current
description: RecoilApp_MissionFmvState::OnTryBecomeCurrent synchronizes mission id state, rebuilds mission ZRDR paths, and starts the mission FMV script when not skipped.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target currently covers this RecoilApp mission-FMV state method.

The direct caller smoke covers both mission-id adoption and pushback with mission FMV skipping enabled. The non-skipped action load and BeginAtTime behavior are covered by the listed zFMV script functional smokes, while Binary Ninja/source evidence covers the exact M# tag construction and call order.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x42edb0 validates the m_missionId zero branch through HudSensorTracker::GetMissionId, the nonzero branch through HudSensorTracker::SetMissionId, the zUtil::SetMissionZrdrPathsAndMountZbd call, M# tag construction from the mission id byte, skip gate at m_skipMissionFmv, optional g_RecoilApp_hWndMain assignment to the embedded zFMV script, LoadActionsFromZrd("fmv.zrd", tag), BeginAtTime on successful load, and return value one.

The native mission-FMV smoke verifies the skip path leaves the script HWND untouched while adopting the current HUD mission id, pushing an explicit mission id back to the HUD tracker, and rebuilding mission ZRDR/image resource path globals.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x42edb0 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
